title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.03.5 — community fixes
notes:
Complete DAW release for Windows, Linux x64, Apple-silicon Mac and Intel Mac. Organized forum replies with quoted parent context and per-report completion. Added sample-browser scrollbar and Up/Down preview, compact CPU meter, ZIP recent-project history and clearer update states. Starting playback cancels browser audition to avoid doubling the first hit. Mac updates check for a writable installed app location. Includes current built-in Lemon Wave and all prior changes. Personal recorded libraries are excluded. Updated Change Log. Device-specific crackling, exact Tahoe update failure, vendor ARA playback and Masterdesk preset issues remain unconfirmed. Linux compiled without runtime/audio testing. Mac packages ad-hoc signed.
